add.event: 政府认定注资不足以挽救，Anglo Irish Bank 被国有化
add.evidence: Anglo Irish was nationalised on 20 January 2009, when the Irish government determined that recapitalisation would not be enough to save the bank.

add.event: 财长 Lenihan 宣布向AIB与BoI各提供35亿欧元救助
add.evidence: On 11 February 2009, Lenihan announced the provision of two €3.5 billion bailouts to AIB and BoI as part of his government's recapitalisation scheme.

add.event: 爱尔兰成功退出救助计划
add.evidence: On 15 December 2013, Ireland successfully exited the bailout programme, with market bond rates at a recent historic low.

add.event: 国债管理机构NTMA以更低利率借款，偿还90亿欧元IMF贷款
add.evidence: In December 2014, Ireland's debt management body, the NTMA, repaid €9 billion in IMF loans, by borrowing that €9 billion at cheaper rates.
